clips.title: The story
paras: At Aldrassil, Dirania Silvershine grows worried when Iverron misses his daily visit. She asks travelers to search the hills near Shadowthread Cave, north of Shadowglen.
Dirania Silvershine waits beneath Aldrassil for Iverron, who visits her every day. Hours pass without him, and she asks travelers heading into Shadowglen to look for her friend.

Iverron often wanders the hills in northern Shadowglen, near the webwood spiders of Shadowthread Cave. The spiders make the surrounding slopes dangerous for travelers. Search west of the cave entrance, where Iverron is hiding and needs help.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A friend of mine named Iverron usually visits me at the same time every day. The strange thing is that he hasn't been by today at all -- he's several hours late, in fact.
I admit, I am a little worried, friend. Iverron spends a lot of time over by the cave to the north, and I'm sure you know how dangerous it is there -- spiders, everywhere!
If you happen to be going that way, though, will you keep an eye out for him?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm so glad you found me, friend. How did you know I was here?
